title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (May 2026)
summary: A monthly Hacker News community discussion thread where developers and tech professionals share what projects they're working on, new ideas they're exploring, and seek feedback from the community.
problem_solved: Facilitates community connection, project feedback, collaboration opportunities, and discovery of interesting side projects among developers.
why_valuable: Provides visibility for side projects, enables peer feedback, sparks collaboration, and keeps the developer community informed about what others are building.
